summary: Backend-only testing of CleanTec Manutenzione module (ticket guasti + interventi + storico). 131/131 tests passing: 107 regression + 24 new Manutenzione. All requested features verified: seeded tickets (TKT-2026-00001..00004), filters (stato, priorita, macchina_id), auto-numbering via atomic next_seq counter, fermo_macchina side-effects on macchina.stato (guasto on create / disponibile on resolve), RBAC (_WRITE_ROLES=admin,produzione; qualita/logistica/contabilita/cliente all 403), admin-only DELETE with cascade on interventi, intervento auto-recompute totali and auto-transition aperto→in_lavorazione, date string coercion to BSON datetime, storico-manutenzione aggregate, dashboard KPI tickets_aperti, counter seq synced, indexes on tickets & interventi.
critical_code_review_comments: manutenzione.py _recompute_ticket_totals reads interventi then overwrites interventi_count/durata_totale_min/costo_totale. This read-then-write is non-atomic — concurrent POST /interventi on same ticket could race and leave totals behind the true sum. Low probability in practice but worth noting (consider $inc-based accumulation or findOneAndUpdate aggregation pipeline).

update_ticket: when PATCHing stato=risolto/chiuso, chiuso_at is set via setdefault; however if an admin explicitly passes chiuso_at the code does not re-validate/coerce it via to_dt, so a caller could store a string. Not covered by the API contract (PatchTicketIn does not list chiuso_at) so extra=ignore drops it — OK in practice.
list_tickets has no pagination cap enforcement beyond limit param default 500; fine for demo scale but should add a max cap for prod.

_update_macchina_stato overwrites macchina.stato unconditionally on resolve (back to 'disponibile'). If a machine was already in 'manutenzione'/'in_uso' for another reason when the ticket is resolved, this resets it — minor edge case.

Auto-transition aperto→in_lavorazione uses ticket.stato fetched BEFORE insert; if two interventi are posted concurrently both may observe 'aperto' and both try to set 'in_lavorazione' — idempotent so no harm, but worth knowing.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_create_basic, TEST_fermo, TEST_interv, TEST_close, TEST_delete, TEST_admin_allowed, TEST_rbac, TEST_404 tickets. No cleanup added (small demo DB); none modify seeded data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 131 backend tests green (107 regression + 24 Manutenzione). test_manutenzione.py covers: list+filters (stato/priorita/macchina_id), create+auto-numero TKT-YYYY-NNNNN, fermo_macchina→macchina.stato guasto/disponibile lifecycle, 404 on missing macchina, GET ticket with embedded interventi sorted desc, POST intervento auto-transition aperto→in_lavorazione + totals recompute + date string→BSON datetime, PATCH stato=chiuso sets chiuso_at, DELETE admin-only with cascade on interventi, storico-manutenzione aggregate, RBAC blocking qualita/logistica/contabilita/cliente (_WRITE_ROLES=admin,produzione), counter 'ticket' synced in db.counters, dashboard KPI tickets_aperti, indexes on tickets.(id,macchina_id,stato,created_at) and interventi.(ticket_id,data_intervento).
